nodes.description: bytes32 public merkleRoot used to verify claim proofs; set in constructor and by setMerkleRoot.
address public rings; address of the ERC721 ring collection used for ownerOf and transferFrom.
bool public paused; circuit breaker checked in claimRing and set by setPaused.
mapping(address => bool) public claimed; tracks which addresses have already claimed a ring.
Public claim function: validates pause state, claim status, token owner and merkle proof, then marks claimed and transfers the token.
onlyOwner function that updates the rings contract address.
onlyOwner function that updates the paused flag.
Constructor of RingDrop initializing merkleRoot and rings from arguments.
Caller-controlled address used for claim tracking, merkle leaf computation and transfer recipient.
External call IERC721(rings).transferFrom(tokenOwner, msg.sender, tokenId) performing the actual ring transfer.
bytes32[] merkle proof supplied by the caller of claimRing.
uint256 identifier of the ring token to claim, supplied by the caller.
Local address holding the current owner of tokenId, read via IERC721(rings).ownerOf.
Ownable view returning the current _owner address; used in the tokenOwner == owner() check.
Ownable onlyOwner function transferring ownership to a new address.
Private address in Ownable storing the contract owner.

edges.reason: The caller-supplied merkle proof parameter is consumed by claimRing for MerkleProof.verify.
The caller-supplied tokenId parameter is used in claimRing for ownerOf and transferFrom.
tokenId flows directly into the external transferFrom call.
tokenOwner local is passed as the 'from' argument of the external transferFrom call.
msg.sender controls the caller and the transfer recipient, enabling reentrant behavior against the external call.
claimRing triggers the external transferFrom call, which is the reentrancy entry point of the contract.
msg.sender determines the claimed mapping slot that gates whether a caller may claim.
claimRing reads and writes the claimed mapping to prevent duplicate claims.
claimRing conditionally reverts based on the paused state variable.
claimRing reads merkleRoot as the root argument to MerkleProof.verify.
claimRing reads the rings address to instantiate the IERC721 interface.
claimRing calls the Ownable owner() function to compare against the token owner.
Only the owner may call setMerkleRoot, which writes the merkleRoot state variable.
Only the owner may call setRings, which writes the rings state variable.
Only the owner may call setPaused, which writes the paused state variable.
Constructor initializes merkleRoot.
Constructor initializes rings.
transferOwnership (onlyOwner) indirectly updates _owner via _setOwner.
renounceOwnership (onlyOwner) indirectly clears _owner via _setOwner.
owner() returns the value stored in the _owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The merkle proof parameter is only meaningful within claimRing where it is consumed by MerkleProof.verify, so it can be folded into that function node.
tokenId is a caller parameter used solely inside claimRing for ownerOf and transferFrom and can be folded into the function node.
The tokenOwner local is derived from ownerOf and immediately passed as the from argument of the external transferFrom call, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
